# ---- Order/OrderSpike PhasedGrid builder — FAITHFUL 4-ROW LEDGER (rebuild 2026-06-14) ----
	# Reproduces the golden per-size-group block, NUMBERS ONLY + COLOR ONLY:
	#   Beg Balance (pooled) -> one Receipts row PER SUPPLIER -> Usage (pooled)
	#   -> End Balance (pooled) -> gray separator (#969696).
	# Pooling rule (parity-verified): pooled = SUM of per-part Section-C values.
	#   Beg(0)=Sum(total_inv-in_transit); Usage=Sum(forecast_usage);
	#   End=Beg+Recv-Usage (PAB); Beg(day+1)=End(day). Receipts row per supplier
	#   = that part's receipt_qty per day PLUS any locally-typed qty (req #4).
	# Colors ONLY: peach #FFCC99 on each supplier's single editable order-by cell
	#   (fill_pos == orderby_col_index); red #FF0000 on an End cell where End < safety.
	# Edit lock (req #2): day columns are editable at column level, but every
	#   NON-order-by day cell carries editable:false; only the peach cell is editable.
	# Live recompute (req #4): typed qtys live in view.custom.editQty keyed
	#   "PART|FILLPOS"; onEditCellCommit writes them + bumps editNonce (in the
	#   binding expression) so this transform re-runs and folds them into pooled End.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	# value is the upstream expr binding: partType|fillDays|today|sortBy|lineName|runNonce|editNonce
	parts = unicode(value).split("|")
	ptype  = parts[0]
	fd     = int(float(parts[1]))
	today  = parts[2]
	line   = parts[4]

	PEACH = "#FFCC99"   # editable order-by cell (legacy ColorIndex 40)
	RED   = "#FF0000"   # End < safety stock (below-safety font)
	SEP   = "#969696"   # gray block separator (golden)
	BEGBG = "#EEF3F8"; USEBG = "#FFFFFF"; ENDBG = "#F4F6F8"; RECBG = "#FFFFFF"
	LBLBG = "#ECEFF1"

	# typed order qtys overlaid client-side (req #4). Keys "PART|FILLPOS" -> int.
	editQty = {}
	try:
		raw = self.view.custom.editQty
		if raw is not None:
			for k in raw.keys():
				v = raw[k]
				editQty[unicode(k)] = int(v) if v not in (None, "") else 0
	except Exception, e:
		log.warn("SPIKE editQty read failed: %s" % e)

	# IG81-COMPAT: one proc call per section (Ignition reads only the first result set).
	common = "@LineName=?,@PartType=?,@SortType=?,@Today=?,@FillDays=?,@ForecastUsageCompare=7,@UseFirstProductionDay=1"
	args = [line, ptype, 'PART NUMBER', today, fd]
	dsA = system.db.runPrepQuery("EXEC dbo.SIM_OrderSimulation " + common + ",@Section='A'", args, DB)
	dsB = system.db.runPrepQuery("EXEC dbo.SIM_OrderSimulation " + common + ",@Section='B'", args, DB)
	dsC = system.db.runPrepQuery("EXEC dbo.SIM_OrderSimulation " + common + ",@Section='C'", args, DB)
	log.info("SPIKE grid: A=%d B=%d C=%d rows (line=%s type=%s fd=%d edits=%d)" % (dsA.rowCount, dsB.rowCount, dsC.rowCount, line, ptype, fd, len(editQty)))

	# ---- columns: frozen-left label + identity, then one column per production day ----
	wk = ["","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun"]
	dayCols = []          # ordered fill_pos list
	columns = []
	for f, t, w, sticky in [("label","",130,"left"),("size","Size",70,"left"),("sup","Brand / Supplier",130,"left"),("lead","Lead",55,None)]:
		col = {"field": f, "header": {"title": t}, "editable": False}
		if w: col["strictWidth"] = w
		if sticky: col["sticky"] = sticky
		columns.append(col)
	for r in xrange(dsA.rowCount):
		fp = int(dsA.getValueAt(r, "fill_pos"))
		sd = str(dsA.getValueAt(r, "serial_date"))[:10]
		wd = wk[int(dsA.getValueAt(r, "weekday"))]
		dayCols.append(fp)
		# day columns editable at column level so per-cell editable:false can LOCK them
		columns.append({"field": "d%d" % fp, "header": {"title": "%s %s" % (wd, sd[5:])}, "strictWidth": 78, "editable": True, "align": "right"})

	# ---- Section C -> per-(part,fill_pos): forecast_usage, receipt_qty ----
	cFc = {}; cRec = {}
	for r in xrange(dsC.rowCount):
		pn = dsC.getValueAt(r, "part_number")
		fp = int(dsC.getValueAt(r, "fill_pos"))
		fcv = dsC.getValueAt(r, "forecast_usage"); rcv = dsC.getValueAt(r, "receipt_qty")
		cFc[(pn, fp)] = int(fcv) if fcv is not None else 0
		cRec[(pn, fp)] = int(rcv) if rcv is not None else 0

	# ---- Section B -> size groups (ordered), per-part identity + order-by index ----
	order = []; gmap = {}
	for r in xrange(dsB.rowCount):
		if dsB.getValueAt(r, "row_kind") != "PART":
			continue
		sc = dsB.getValueAt(r, "size_code")
		if sc not in gmap:
			ss = dsB.getValueAt(r, "safety_stock")
			gmap[sc] = {"size_name": dsB.getValueAt(r, "size_name"),
			            "safety": int(ss) if ss is not None else 0, "parts": []}
			order.append(sc)
		ob = dsB.getValueAt(r, "orderby_col_index")
		ti = dsB.getValueAt(r, "total_inv"); it = dsB.getValueAt(r, "in_transit")
		gmap[sc]["parts"].append({
			"pn": dsB.getValueAt(r, "part_number"),
			"sup": dsB.getValueAt(r, "supplier_name"),
			"lead": dsB.getValueAt(r, "lead_time"),
			"orderby": int(ob) if ob is not None else None,
			"total_inv": int(ti) if ti is not None else 0,
			"in_transit": int(it) if it is not None else 0,
		})

	def dcell(v, bg=None, fg=None, bold=False, editable=False):
		o = {"value": v, "editable": editable}
		style = {}
		if bg: style["backgroundColor"] = bg
		if fg: style["color"] = fg
		if bold: style["fontWeight"] = "bold"
		if style: o["style"] = style
		return o

	# ---- build the 4-row ledger per size group (pooled), folding in typed edits ----
	rows = []
	for sc in order:
		g = gmap[sc]; parts = g["parts"]; safety = g["safety"]
		beg0 = sum(p["total_inv"] - p["in_transit"] for p in parts)
		# pooled usage + pooled receipts (base + typed) per day
		usage = {}; pooledRecv = {}
		for fp in dayCols:
			usage[fp] = sum(cFc.get((p["pn"], fp), 0) for p in parts)
			base = sum(cRec.get((p["pn"], fp), 0) for p in parts)
			typed = sum(editQty.get("%s|%d" % (p["pn"], fp), 0) for p in parts)
			pooledRecv[fp] = base + typed
		# pooled PAB recurrence
		beg = beg0; pBeg = {}; pEnd = {}
		for fp in dayCols:
			pBeg[fp] = beg
			pEnd[fp] = beg + pooledRecv[fp] - usage[fp]
			beg = pEnd[fp]

		# Beg Balance row (pooled)
		br = {"label": dcell("Beg Balance", bg=LBLBG), "size": sc, "sup": "", "lead": ""}
		for fp in dayCols:
			br["d%d" % fp] = dcell(pBeg[fp], bg=BEGBG)
		rows.append(br)

		# Receipts row PER SUPPLIER
		for p in parts:
			# hidden fields (no matching column): part_number + order-by fill_pos
			# let the onEditCellCommit handler validate the one editable cell cheaply.
			rr = {"label": dcell("Receipts", bg=LBLBG), "size": sc, "sup": p["sup"], "lead": p["lead"],
			      "part": p["pn"], "_obfp": (p["orderby"] if p["orderby"] is not None else -1)}
			for fp in dayCols:
				base = cRec.get((p["pn"], fp), 0)
				typed = editQty.get("%s|%d" % (p["pn"], fp), 0)
				v = base + typed
				if fp == p["orderby"]:
					# the ONE valid, editable, peach cell (req #2 + #3)
					rr["d%d" % fp] = dcell(v, bg=PEACH, editable=True)
				else:
					rr["d%d" % fp] = dcell(v if v else "", bg=RECBG, editable=False)
			rows.append(rr)

		# Usage row (pooled)
		ur = {"label": dcell("Usage", bg=LBLBG), "size": sc, "sup": "", "lead": ""}
		for fp in dayCols:
			ur["d%d" % fp] = dcell(usage[fp], bg=USEBG)
		rows.append(ur)

		# End Balance row (pooled) — red where End < safety stock (req #1)
		er = {"label": dcell("End Balance", bg=LBLBG), "size": sc, "sup": "", "lead": ""}
		for fp in dayCols:
			v = pEnd[fp]
			if safety > 0 and v < safety:
				er["d%d" % fp] = dcell(v, bg=ENDBG, fg=RED, bold=True)
			else:
				er["d%d" % fp] = dcell(v, bg=ENDBG)
		rows.append(er)

		# gray separator row
		sep = {"label": dcell("", bg=SEP), "size": dcell("", bg=SEP), "sup": dcell("", bg=SEP), "lead": dcell("", bg=SEP)}
		for fp in dayCols:
			sep["d%d" % fp] = dcell("", bg=SEP)
		rows.append(sep)

	return {"data": rows, "columns": columns}

# Force-rerun SIM_OrderSimulation (legacy 'Start'). Bumping runNonce changes
	# the gridModel expression input -> re-fires binding + transform.
	self.view.custom.runNonce = (self.view.custom.runNonce or 0) + 1
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("Simulate clicked -> runNonce=" + str(self.view.custom.runNonce))

# Clear all locally-typed order qtys and recompute the clean ledger (req #4).
	self.view.custom.editQty = {}
	self.view.custom.editNonce = (self.view.custom.editNonce or 0) + 1
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("Reset typed orders -> nonce=" + str(self.view.custom.editNonce))

config.script:
# onEditCellCommit — req #2 (lock to one cell) + req #4 (live recompute).
	# Day columns are editable at column level; the builder validates with two hidden
	# scalar fields on each Receipts row: "part" (part number) and "_obfp" (the
	# order-by fill_pos). A commit is VALID only when the row label is "Receipts"
	# and the committed day column d<fp> matches that row's _obfp (the single peach
	# cell). Valid -> store typed qty in view.custom.editQty["PART|FILLPOS"] and bump
	# editNonce so the gridModel binding re-runs and folds it into the pooled End.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	col = event.column            # e.g. "d5"
	rowIdx = event.row
	newVal = event.value
	if not (isinstance(col, basestring) and col.startswith("d") and col[1:].isdigit()):
		log.info("SPIKE edit IGNORED (non-day col %s)" % col)
		return
	rows = self.view.custom.gridModel.data
	if rowIdx < 0 or rowIdx >= len(rows):
		log.warn("SPIKE edit: row %s out of range" % rowIdx)
		return
	srcRow = rows[rowIdx]
	label = srcRow["label"]
	labelTxt = label["value"] if hasattr(label, "keys") else label
	obfp = srcRow["_obfp"] if "_obfp" in srcRow else None
	fp = int(col[1:])
	if labelTxt != "Receipts" or obfp is None or int(obfp) != fp:
		log.info("SPIKE edit REJECTED (locked): row=%s col=%s label=%s obfp=%s" % (rowIdx, col, labelTxt, obfp))
		return
	try:
		qty = int(round(float(newVal))) if newVal not in (None, "") else 0
	except Exception:
		log.warn("SPIKE edit non-numeric '%s' ignored" % newVal)
		return
	pn = srcRow["part"]
	key = "%s|%d" % (pn, fp)
	edits = dict(self.view.custom.editQty) if self.view.custom.editQty else {}
	if qty == 0:
		edits.pop(key, None)
	else:
		edits[key] = qty
	self.view.custom.editQty = edits
	self.view.custom.editNonce = (self.view.custom.editNonce or 0) + 1
	log.info("SPIKE edit ACCEPTED: %s = %d (nonce=%d, %d total edits)" % (key, qty, self.view.custom.editNonce, len(edits)))
